pages.text: Grandpa's boat had a big net. Folded neatly, it unfolded easily next day.
Bung wanted to fold it straight, rolled up both sleeves, and sat before it. "Today I will fold it, Grandpa."
Ddori shook the net end. Bung moved the net out of reach.
Bung put every interesting thing up high. Nothing remained before Ddori.
Ddori hung on Bung's clothes. Bung's hands kept stopping.
Bung folded one side; Ddori pulled the other. The net tangled again.
The net became a messy heap. Bung plopped onto it.
Grandpa pushed a short piece of cord before Bung, then stepped back.
Bung gave Ddori the cord. Ddori played winding and unwinding it.
Bung's hands worked steadily, folding the net neat. Grandpa laid a hand on Bung's head.
